name: The Offices at Firewheel Town Center
summary: The Offices at Firewheel Town Center is a professional office complex managed by Simon Property Group, located within Garland's premier Firewheel Town Center development. The property offers businesses a prestigious address with convenient access to the area's extensive retail, dining, and entertainment amenities.
demographics: The Offices at Firewheel Town Center attracts a professional demographic of business owners, executives, and corporate employees primarily in the 30-55 age range with above-average household incomes of $75,000-$150,000. The surrounding Garland area serves a diverse suburban population with a mix of young families and established professionals seeking convenient office and retail services. The trade area draws from northeast Dallas suburbs with visitors who value accessibility, modern amenities, and proximity to the larger Firewheel Town Center retail complex.
description: The Offices at Firewheel Town Center is a premier office and professional services complex located in Garland, Texas, strategically positioned within the thriving Firewheel Town Center development. Managed by Simon Property Group, one of the nation's leading retail real estate companies, this property offers a sophisticated business environment at 245 Cedar Sage Drive. The center benefits from its integration with the larger Firewheel Town Center ecosystem, providing tenants and visitors with convenient access to shopping, dining, and entertainment options. With operating hours from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, the facility caters to professional businesses seeking a prestigious address in the dynamic northeast Dallas market. The property has earned strong community recognition with a 4.4-star rating from over 515 reviews, reflecting its quality management and desirable location within one of Garland's most successful mixed-use developments.
